scope: Confirmed in user-supplied 0.3.1/0.3.2 native phone sessions and physical lock/unlock report. Placeholder identities only; no real account request submitted by the agent.

recipes.label: Login
recipes.confirmed: HTTP 200 with access_token; keep only in memory and enforce expires_in

recipes.label: Vehicle enrollment
recipes.confirmed: HTTP 200 with one active record in enrolledVehicleDetails; the same-session encoded-@ form failed C500
recipes.encoding: Use encodeURIComponent(username), then replace only %40 with @. Preserve encoding for all other delimiters.

recipes.label: Cached vehicle status
recipes.confirmed: HTTP 200 with vehicleStatus; later cached timestamps advanced. dateTime still determines freshness.

recipes.label: Requested fresh vehicle status
recipes.confirmed: HTTP 200 response, identical to cached body and dateTime

recipes.label: Unlock
recipes.confirmed: HTTP 200 with empty body and tmstid; user reports physical success. Sole recorded poll was PENDING, not terminal SUCCESS.

recipes.label: Lock
recipes.confirmed: HTTP 200 with empty body and tmstid; subsequent poll SUCCESS and user reports physical success.

recipes.label: Lock/unlock transaction result
recipes.confirmed: HTTP 200 with nextPollingInterval, tid and status. Unlock poll PENDING; lock poll SUCCESS. Empty command bodies do not imply completion.

tasker_constraints: Keep token and session secrets in volatile Java objects; any remembered credentials must use native encrypted storage, never ordinary persistent Tasker variables
Preserve original bridge project; confirm actual imported actions and runtime on the phone
Lock and unlock have user-reported physical success; other controls and automatic profiles remain disabled until individually confirmed
Never resend a command with unknown outcome; preserve its transaction and physical acknowledgement gate
recipe_correction: Earlier derived documentation incorrectly named owners.hyundaiusa.com. The confirmed runtime and supplied requests consistently use api.telematics.hyundaiusa.com; runtime endpoints were not changed.
